text: Figure 5.3: Common model elements relevant for the Dcm [TPS_DEXT_01011] Semantics of DiagnosticSession.id⌈The value of the attribute DiagnosticSession.id has a given semantics according to ISO 14229- 1 [16]. For the sake of completeness, the dedicated values of DiagnosticSession. id are: 0x01 This represents the default session. This session has a specific semantics in the context of diagnostics communication such that e.g. any diagnostic service that is supposed to execute in the default session cannot require any reference to a DiagnosticSecurityLevel. 0x02 This represents the programming session. 0x03 This represents the extended diagnostic session . 0x04 This represents the safety system diagnostic session . The value range 0x40 .. 0x5F is reserved for manufacturer-specific use.⌋(RS_DEXT_- 00040) Class DiagnosticSecurityLevel Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::DiagnosticExtract::Dcm Note This meta-class represents the ability to define a security level considered for diagnostic purposes.
